description: Domain radar: newly registered names from our discovery queue (NRD, registries, GitHub orgs). This is NOT a company profile. Returns apex, registration date, registrar, mailbox signal, quality score, and status (queued / quality_failed). startup_slug is set only after we promote a real homepage into the directory. Always sorted newest first (created_at desc). Use search_startups for companies. Pro Lite and higher. 1 db credit. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

apex.description: Exact hostname lookup, e.g. acme.ai. A leading www. is stripped; a value with no dot returns 400 invalid_apex. Overrides q.

created_after.description: ISO date. Rows we first ingested on or after this time.

created_before.description: ISO date. Rows we first ingested on or before this time.

has_real_content.description: Last homepage probe found real body copy.

has_real_email.description: Mailbox on the domain (MX is not empty).

offset.description: Skip this many rows, for paging.

promoted.description: 'true' = only names that already have a public startup profile.

q.description: Substring match on apex or candidate name. Needs at least 2 characters after removing % _ and commas, otherwise no filter.

source.description: Comma-separated raw source or bucket ids, e.g. 'dot_ai_nrd', 'dot_ai_zone', 'github_new_org', 'uk_companies_house'.

status.description: Comma-separated: queued, quality_failed, promoted, rejected. Default is queued,quality_failed.

tld.description: Comma-separated TLDs, e.g. 'ai,io'. Only ai, io, xyz, so, com and security filter anything; other values apply no filter. Maps to the NRD/CT sources and combines with source by OR.

name: search_domains
title: Search new domains
